notes: Contents on pdf pp.4-9 (text layer + 300dpi OCR of number columns, then fixed by eye against page images). Page numbers: 507 of 539 entries confirmed by finding the title on pdf page = printed+2 in the OCR text layer; 21 more confirmed by tesseract of the full page; American Pie corrected to p.24 after finding it on pdf 26. No artist credits are printed in this book (no 'Recorded by' lines; top-fifth OCR of all pages found none), so artist is omitted. Composer filled only where the page text layer gave a clean credit; many tunes start mid-page so composer is blank for many. Tune pages checked by rendering: see report. Contents-page index lists some songs at the same page (two tunes on one page). Composer kept only for tunes alone on their page with a clean credit; some may be partial (co-writers dropped by OCR).
